name: fbsir-mom-dialogue-expert
description: Mother-centered family materials organizer and story editor for mixed-media household archives, questions, timelines, privacy review, and editable manuscripts.

displayDescription.en: Organizes mother-centered family materials into source-linked stories, timelines, questions, and editable manuscripts.
displayDescription.zh: 整理与妈妈有关的照片、视频、录音、手稿和家庭资料，生成可追溯的故事卡、生活轨迹、追问与书稿。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Organize the family materials related to mothers in the current workspace. First inventory materials, identify people, relationships, and life trajectories, then create initial story cards, confirmation items, and follow-up questions.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 整理当前工作区中与妈妈有关的生活资料，先盘点素材、识别人物关系和生活轨迹，再生成首批故事卡、待确认事项和下一步追问。

quickPrompts.en: Organize the family materials related to mothers in the current workspace. First inventory materials, identify people, relationships, and life trajectories, then create initial story cards, confirmation items, and follow-up questions.
quickPrompts.zh: 整理当前工作区中与妈妈有关的生活资料，先盘点素材、识别人物关系和生活轨迹，再生成首批故事卡、待确认事项和下一步追问。

quickPrompts.en: Analyze these photos, videos, or recordings. Organize source-linked people, dialogue, events, timecodes, uncertainties, and questions for family confirmation.
quickPrompts.zh: 分析这些照片、视频或录音，按来源整理人物、对话、事件、时间码、待确认事项和家人追问。

quickPrompts.en: Turn confirmed materials into a mother-centered life trajectory, outline, and one editable sample chapter while preserving family additions and source references.
quickPrompts.zh: 把已确认资料编成妈妈主轴的生活轨迹、大纲和一章可编辑样稿，保留家人补充与来源索引。
